subject: POC scope, SLA gating, and evaluation onboarding plan
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Hill <alex.hill@stratahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 30 Sep 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC scope, SLA gating, and evaluation onboarding plan

Hi Alex — great conversation earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth before kickoff.

Summary of what we heard from StrataHealth:
- Primary use: clinical note summarization + snug retrieval for snippets in the clinician UI.
- Target concurrency: bursty peaks up to ~120 req/s, sustained baseline ~40 req/s.
- Quality bar: physicians should accept autogenerated notes >= 85% of the time on blind samples.
- Compliance notes: data must remain in your VPC option for production; SOC2 evidence required for procurement.

Proposed POC objectives (success gating):
1) Latency: p50 end-to-end < 50ms, p95 < 220ms for 512-token prompts (measured from our SDK endpoint to Redwood inference completion).
2) Throughput: sustain 100 req/s for 15-minute window without tail p99 spikes > 500ms.
3) Cost: average inference cost <= $0.003/token for the evaluation workload (based on provided sample tokens).
4) Quality: >= 85% clinician accept rate on a 200-sample blind set OR equivalent automated quality metric (A/B to be decided).
5) Reliability: error rate < 0.5% and no unplanned fallback to lower-capacity regions during the 4-week evaluation.

Proposed timeline (draft):
- Week 0 (this week): kickoff, access & network checks, sign mutual NDA/POC order schedule.
- Week 1: smoke tests (sanity + security scans), baseline latency/throughput profiling.
- Weeks 2-5: 4-week evaluation window with continuous instrumentation, weekly readouts.
- Week 6: final readout, knowledge transfer, procurement handoff (if criteria met).

Ownership & immediate action items:
- Tessa Morgan (Sales): coordinate kickoff, procurement contacts, and weekly readout cadence. Due: Tue 10/7
- Ben Carter (Solutions Eng): infra sizing, perf harness, and test plan (includes batching/blocking params). Deliverables: perf-run + recommended instance counts. Due: Fri 10/3
- Monica Patel (CS): success criteria definition for clinician QA workflow and human-rater rubric. Due: Fri 10/3
- Karthik Iyer (Security): gather SOC2 artifacts and confirm VPC onboarding steps. Due: Wed 10/8

Attachments: poc-metrics-template.xlsx (template for submitting gold prompts and token estimates); network-security-profile.pdf (sample onboarding checklist).

Next steps for you, Alex:
1) Share a 200-sample de-identified prompt set (or sample rate + access plan) so we can compute token projections.
2) Confirm whether the acceptance metric should be blind clinician rating or automated similarity threshold.
3) Tell us your preferred kickoff slot (we proposed Wed 10/8 or Thu 10/9 afternoons PT).

I’ll set a calendar hold for Wed 10/8 1pm PT tentatively. If that works, Ben and Monica will use the call to align on instrumentation and QA rubric.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this running.

—
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise SDR, Redwood Inference
(t) 415-555-0181
From: Alex Hill <alex.hill@stratahealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference>
Cc: prod-eng@stratahealth.com
Date: Wed, 01 Oct 2025 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC scope, SLA gating, and evaluation onboarding plan

Tessa — thanks for the clear recap. This aligns with our expectations; a few clarifications below.

1) Timeline: the team prefers a 6-week evaluation if possible (we have an internal ops window and need extra time for clinical sampling). Can Redwood support extending the evaluation window to 6 weeks?
2) Data retention: for the POC we need logs to be retained for 30 days in our project account; production will require VPC-only.
3) Monitoring: can you expose a Grafana dashboard (or hosted readout) for latency and error-rate during the POC? Prod will need alerting hooks.
4) Cost: the $0.003/token target is realistic, but we need a run-rate estimate for the projected 1M tokens over the evaluation window.

We can provide the 200 de-identified prompts by EOD Friday and are good with a kickoff the week of Oct 6 if that helps move things along.

On a separate note, can you share a redacted SOC2 scope doc so our procurement team can start internal approvals?

Alex
Alex Hill
Head of Product Operations, StrataHealth
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 01 Oct 2025 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC scope, SLA gating, and evaluation onboarding plan

Quick technical note for the perf/ops plan before the kickoff:

- Perf harness: we’ll run two baseline profiles: (A) representative clinical prompt distribution at 512 tokens and (B) worst-case 2048-token prompts to validate KV-cache sizing.
- Batching & latency: our runtime supports continuous batching with dynamic batch caps. To hit p50 < 50ms at 40-100 rps we recommend an initial config using 2x A100-equivalent GPUs (dedicated) with conservative batch window ~12ms. I’ll validate with a smoke run.
- Throughput: to sustain 100 req/s without p99 tail >500ms we’ll instrument prefix caching for repeat contexts (expected to reduce tokens/tokenize by ~18% on your sample).
- Cost estimate: preliminary math based on the token projection you’ll provide — rough ballpark for 1M tokens: $3,000 at $0.003/token. We’ll refine after we see the sample distribution.
- Observability: we can spin up a shared Grafana dashboard for latency/error/drop counts and an S3 bucket for perf traces. Karthik — can you confirm the allowed IPs for the VPC peering?

I’ll prepare a short perf-run checklist and an infra sizing doc (attachment stub) before the call.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Hill <alex.hill@stratahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 02 Oct 2025 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC scope, SLA gating, and evaluation onboarding plan

Alex — perfect, appreciate the quick replies and the flexibility on timeline. Confirming items below and next steps: 

- Evaluation window: OK to extend to 6 weeks. We’ll run Week 1 smoke + Weeks 2-6 evaluation + Week 7 readout.
- Retention & security: Karthik will send the SOC2 redacted scope and a short doc on VPC onboarding steps (expect in the next 48 hours).
- Monitoring: Ben will provision a Grafana readout and share access during Week 1 smoke.
- Tokens/run-rate: please send the 200 de-identified prompts by EOD Fri 10/3; we’ll return an updated cost/run-rate estimate within 48 hours of receiving them.

Action items confirmed:
- Tessa: send calendar invite for kickoff on Tue 10/7 11am PT (tentative) and DocuSign POC order.
- Ben: perf harness + initial sizing doc (due Fri 10/3).
- Monica: QA rubric and sampling plan (due Fri 10/3).
- Karthik: SOC2 redacted scope + VPC IP list (due Mon 10/6).

Attachments attached again: poc-metrics-template.xlsx, network-security-profile.pdf.

Thanks — I’ll send the invite and DocuSign shortly. Looking forward to getting this moving.

—
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise SDR, Redwood Inference
